project_info.theme: Friendly AI companion at a sunlit study window

prompt.main_subject: An explicitly adult AI companion character with dark hair in a loose updo, wearing a modest cream sleeveless blouse in a warm study.
prompt.composition_elements: Subjective POV close framing beside a leather chair, warm wood shelves and window behind, one raised hand briefly blocking the lens, then a friendly face-forward close-up.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Late-afternoon window light around 4200K creates soft gold backlight, realistic skin texture, quiet study ambience, and subtle fabric rustle.

technical_specs.camera: 35mm-equivalent subjective POV with shallow depth of field and subtle film grain.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Maintain a subjective POV. An explicitly adult AI companion character with dark hair in a loose updo sits in a warm study by a window, wearing a modest cream sleeveless blouse. She smiles and gently raises a hand toward the lens, saying in a playful tone, "Oh, stop filming me for a second." She lowers her hand and leans forward slightly so her face fills more of the frame. Looking directly at the camera, she says, "I am here to help you make something good. What should we create next?" Include quiet city ambience outside the window, warm natural light, subtle fabric rustle, realistic detail, and gentle film grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, minor, consent-ambiguous language, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference is mandatory. Preserve explicitly adult AI-companion framing, friendly POV interaction, covered wardrobe, warm study, and non-sexual dialogue. Do not introduce sexual or consent-ambiguous language.

omni_video_prompt.scene_description: An explicitly adult AI companion sits in a warm study by a window, briefly blocks a subjective camera with her hand, then offers friendly creative help.
omni_video_prompt.style: Warm natural-light POV character video with subtle film grain and digital-companion tone.
omni_video_prompt.camera_direction: 35mm-equivalent subjective POV, close face-forward framing, shallow depth of field.
omni_video_prompt.lighting: Late-afternoon 4200K window light with soft gold backlight.
omni_video_prompt.voice: Adult woman speaks the two supplied English dialogue lines in a friendly playful tone.
omni_video_prompt.SFX: Quiet city ambience outside and subtle fabric rustle.
omni_video_prompt.environment: Warm study with wood shelves, leather chair, and window.

element.companion: Explicitly adult AI character with dark loose updo and cream blouse.
